niche_preference_profile: Prefers polished, calm interfaces that feel airy, soft, and visually resolved. They consistently like light or soft-gray canvases, open spacing, restrained styling, muted/pastel accents, and clear structured hierarchy. They favor full, complete screens with evenly paced rows or sections, especially when content feels comprehensive rather than sparse or unfinished. They also respond well to warmer, more welcoming editorial presentation over cold, system-like utility-heavy layouts.

criteria.description: More open spacing, generous breathing room, and an even vertical rhythm rather than compressed or tightly packed layouts.
Soft, restrained, understated styling with gentle surfaces, subtle dividers, muted contrast, and less visually loud treatment.
Interfaces that feel fully resolved, intentional, and complete rather than sparse, prototype-like, awkward, or unfinished.
A warmer, more human, welcoming, and editorial feel rather than a colder, procedural, or system-oriented presentation.
Clear, disciplined hierarchy with logically organized sections, strong progression, and easy-to-scan grouping.
Muted pastel or soft multicolor accents that feel cohesive and gentle rather than saturated, arbitrary, or harsh.
Screens that feel meaningfully populated and comprehensive, with filled-out sections and visible useful content rather than empty or underdeveloped areas.
